messages:
sara: quick thread: current pin metadata lacks a compact deterministic tie-breaker for simultaneous rollouts across regions.

jon: yup seen flapping in routing tests. idea?

sara: propose minimal flat fields: `pin_schema_version`, `provenance_source`, `provenance_id`, `utc_annotation`, `deploy_id`. keep `provenance_blob` optional opaque string for operator notes.

pri: flat keys make client parsing easier. blob for extras is reasonable.

jon: resolver should prefer `deploy_id` (if globally unique), then `utc_annotation`, then `provenance_id`. avoids relying only on clocks.

pri: add `pin_schema_version` default 1 for existing pins. bump to 2 when we ship.

sara: ops: enforce deploy id uniqueness pattern in deploy pipeline. infra-bot can validate on publish.

infra-bot: note: added deploy-id checker task to pipeline template (WIP).

jon: telemetry: emit `pin_resolution_reason` when fallback occurs so we can alert on tie breaks.

sara: action list: PR to expand pin rows, migration script to tag old pins v1, docs for resolver ordering, console UX show source+reason. I'll open PR tomorrow.

pri: unit tests for resolver and a small pin-audit post-merge.

jon: thanks — move ahead if no objections.

infra-bot: reminder: run `pin-audit --since=2025-03-01` after merge.
